entries.title: Psalms 34:1
segments: A Psalm of David, when he changed his behavior before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise always [shall be] in my mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 34:2
segments: My soul shall make its boast in the LORD; the humble shall hear and be glad.

entries.title: Psalms 34:3
segments: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt His name together.

entries.title: Psalms 34:4
segments: I sought the LORD, and He heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

entries.title: Psalms 34:5
segments: They looked to Him, and were filled with light; and their faces were not ashamed.

entries.title: Psalms 34:6
segments: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard, and saved him out of all his troubles.

entries.title: Psalms 34:7
segments: The Angel of the LORD camps round about those who fear Him, and delivers them.

entries.title: Psalms 34:8
segments: Taste and see that the LORD [is] good; blessed [is] the man [who] trusts in Him.

entries.title: Psalms 34:9
segments: O fear the LORD, His holy ones; for [there is] nothing lacking to those who fear Him.

entries.title: Psalms 34:10
segments: The young lions lack, and suffer hunger; but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.

entries.title: Psalms 34:11
segments: Come, listen to me, [my] sons; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 34:12
segments: Who [is] the man that desires life, and loves days, that he may see good?

entries.title: Psalms 34:13
segments: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking guile.

entries.title: Psalms 34:14
segments: Depart from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

entries.title: Psalms 34:15
segments: The eyes of the LORD [are] on the righteous, and His ears [are open] to their cry.

entries.title: Psalms 34:16
segments: The face of the LORD [is] against those who do evil, to cut off the memory of them from the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 34:17
segments: [The righteous] cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

entries.title: Psalms 34:18
segments: The LORD [is] near to the broken-hearted; and saves those who are of a contrite spirit.

entries.title: Psalms 34:19
segments: Many [are] the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.

entries.title: Psalms 34:20
segments: He keeps all his bones; not one of them is broken.

entries.title: Psalms 34:21
segments: Evil shall slay the wicked; and those who hate the righteous shall be held guilty.

entries.title: Psalms 34:22
segments: The LORD redeems the soul of His servants; and none of them who trust in Him shall be guilty.
